violated_contract: Observability: a reconcile job that completes without materializing output must emit a reconcile_completed_empty diagnostic record.
canonical_prevention: Emit a per-WAL reconcile_completed_empty event at the shared async WAL acknowledgement boundary when a completed job reports zero new and zero updated conversations. Include job/WAL identity, result and segment counts, and retry accounting while preserving completed-job acknowledgement. Behavioral reconciliation tests assert persisted acknowledgement and observable diagnostics for empty results, and no empty-completion event for nonempty results.
